htn_kidney.title: Risks of Major Adverse Kidney Events in Non-Hispanic Black Patients with Diabetes or Hypertension: A Real-World Cohort Study.
htn_kidney.authors: Mayhand KN, Zemke A, Alicic RZ

htn_kidney.abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) disproportionately burdens non-Hispanic Black (NHB) patients who experience a three- to four-fold higher risk of kidney failure than non-Hispanic White (NHW) individuals. Diabetes and hypertension are the leading causes of CKD, yet the influence of race, social context, and clinical factors on major adverse kidney events (MAKEs) remains inadequately understood. This study examined relationships between race, social factors, and MAKE among patients with diabetes or hypertension.
